name: Nakanai Makeinu
source:
My father is the king. My mother, a beggar.
The kid born between them, is a noble, or a loser?

Even if it's the later-

I won't cry.

[From [url=http://hanikamuaisuman.web.fc2.com/game/nm/nm.html]homepage[/url]]
translation:
我的父亲是国王。我的母亲是乞丐。他们生下的孩子，是贵族，还是失败者？即使是后者——我也不会哭。

[来自[url=http://hanikamuaisuman.web.fc2.com/game/nm/nm.html]主页[/url]]
